description: The chart presents a quantitative comparison of model scores across multiple benchmark datasets, showing how three 7B-scale models perform on each benchmark. The horizontal axis contains the benchmark categories labeled “MathVista,” “MathVerse,” “MMMU-Pro,” and “Physics,” arranged left-to-right in that order, with the axis label “Benchmark.” The vertical axis is the value axis labeled “Score,” displayed on a linear scale ranging from 35 to 80, with regularly spaced tick marks at 5-point intervals (35, 40, 45, …, 80). For each benchmark, three adjacent vertical bars are grouped together, with color and label indicated by the legend in the upper-right: SRPO-7B (dark navy), GRPO-7B (medium blue), and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B (light blue). In the MathVista group, the SRPO-7B bar is labeled 75.8, GRPO-7B is 72.3, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B is 68.2. In MathVerse, SRPO-7B is 55.8, GRPO-7B is 52.9, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B is 46.3. In MMMU-Pro, SRPO-7B is 42.3, GRPO-7B is 39.9, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B is 36.9. In Physics, SRPO-7B is 60.6, GRPO-7B is 53.5, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B is 45.4. The bars are not shown as stacked, and no special emphasis (such as outlines or highlighting) is used beyond the numeric value annotations above each bar.
